item.title: Building from Zero After Addiction, Prison, and a Felony
item.description: I spent ages 14-16 in a maximum-security juvenile prison, became a felon at 19, lost almost everything to addiction, and later rebuilt my life through software, open source, and a few people who took a chance on me. This is the condensed story, written for anyone wondering whether they have a future.
item.author: ray.gavin97@gmail.com (Gavin Ray)
